description: Organize topic-relevant filing evidence chronologically across a bounded set of SEC filings. Use this when sequence over time is the primary need. Use filedproof.build_disclosure_lineage when you need persisted same-form evolution and reusable transition state, filedproof.compare_filings for exactly two known accessions, or filedproof.check_disclosure_changes for prioritized monitoring of newly filed changes. The timeline does not invent semantic change or materiality.

filings.description: Maximum number of filings to inspect for this invocation.

forms.description: SEC forms to search. Defaults to 10-K and 10-Q.

history.description: Whether to use bounded historical SEC submission archives when needed.

identifier.description: Ticker, CIK, or exact SEC company name.

item.description: Optional SEC filing item, such as 1A or 7.

limit.description: Maximum number of operation-specific evidence or result records to return.

name: filedproof.build_timeline

outputSchema.description: Structured FiledProof result with operation-specific evidence, provenance, coverage, and uncertainty fields.

title: Build disclosure evidence timeline
